Wine 11.20 native exit-order repair, Cage exit1

Wine remains LGPL-2.1-or-later. The original RPM's Wine license notices remain
in the runtime payload. Complete upstream sources and provider build sources
are identified in source.json; the corresponding source change accompanies it.

The checked transformation replaces the premature close() call with an AArch64
NOP in the exact pinned provider ELF and gives the derived ELF a new build ID.
It is an instruction-level application of the accompanying source change, not
a claim to have recompiled Wine. Reproduction needs the original checked RPM
ELF and the repository's Python transformer. No compiler is required by users.

Native libc exit(status), finalizers and the original process status remain.
Kernel teardown closes the process socket. Cage's normal exit, quiescence and
preservation gates still apply. Original runtime artifacts are never rewritten.
